//: Preconfigured instances of the doxa-simple-map parameterized profile. ONE profile, rendered N ways by preset props. The build step reads this and emits a standalone embeddable page per instance at doxa-simple-map/<instance>/index.html (nested under the profile). This is DISTINCT from tabs (which nest many components into one element) — this SPLITS one profile into many render targets. The base profile (doxa-simple-map/doxa-simple-map/) still accepts live props; these are just named, preset variants for direct embedding.
